title: Payment and Refund of Collection-Service Fees, Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
Payment terms of Patient Financial Services for collection-service fees on **Specimen Collection Appointments**.

## Terms in force

1. A visit type whose list of accepted payment methods is empty carries no patient-paid fees.
2. A paid fee that is later waived is refunded in full to the original payment method within the visit type's refund period in business days.
3. Every fee paid on a visit the laboratory cancelled is refunded where the visit type refunds fees on laboratory cancellation.
4. A payment may be refunded at most once: a payment that already carries a refund line on the visit's fee record is not refunded again.
5. Collection-service fees are separate from test charges: they never appear on a test invoice, are not eligible for payment plans, and are not reduced by financial assistance.

## Retired term — no longer in force

The former term that a fee is paid in full in one payment with a method listed among the visit type's accepted payment methods is **no longer in force**. How the service charges of a collected home visit, and the no-show charge of a missed home visit, are settled now follows their current settlement bases.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Result under these terms |
|---|---|
| A late-cancellation fee was paid by debit card on a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and later waived as a first-occurrence courtesy | Refunded in full to the same debit card within 7 business days |
| A fee paid on a visit the laboratory then cancelled | Refunded — every visit type refunds fees on laboratory cancellation |
| A payment already refunded once | Not refunded a second time |
| A Facility Bedside Collection Visit | No patient-paid fees — its list of payment methods is empty |
| A patient asks to put a no-show fee on a payment plan with test invoices | Collection-service fees are not eligible for payment plans |

superseded_clauses: A fee is paid in full in one payment with a method listed in fee_payment_methods
